<var>
$DPS$ = Damage / Swingrate
$BDPS$ = Gladiator Stats.Total Elapsed Damage / Gladiator Stats.Burn Cooldown
$CDPS$ = ($DPS$) + ($BDPS$)
$MDPS$ = DPS * Max Hits
$MNDPS$ = ($DPS$) * Max Hits
$MBDPS$ = ($BDPS$) * Gladiator Stats.Max Hits
$TED$ = Burn Damage * (Burn Duration / Burn Tick Rate)
$COST$ = 525; 375; 1250; 2125; 6200; 14900
$CE$ = Total Cost / DPS
$MCE$ = Total Cost / Max DPS
$WCFR$ = {{#expr:Gladiator Stats.Swingrate / 1.65 round 3}}
$WCDPS$ = Gladiator Stats.Damage / Swingrate
$WCBDPS$ = Gladiator Stats.Damage / Swingrate + $BDPS$
$MWCNDPS$ = ($WCDPS$) * Gladiator Stats.Max Hits
$MWCDPS$ = DPS * Gladiator Stats.Max Hits
$WCCE$ = $TP$ / DPS
$MWCCE$ = $TP$ / Max DPS
$TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$
$FSE-UPGRADE$ = Arena Conditioning; Warrior's Call; Champion's Flame; Centurion; King of the Arena
$FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = 3356186535; 141745478; 4118882122; 16620737; 16868189
$FSE-DETECTION$ = 0; 3;
$FSE-META$ = Exclusive; File:GladiatorIconn.png
$DREF$ = <ref>DPS assumes that only one enemy is hit per swing and it is set on fire.<br/>Ability is not taken into account.<br/>Burn DPS is calculated as (Burn Damage * (Burn Duration / Burn Tick)) / Burn Cooldown.</ref>
$D2REF$ = <ref>DPS assumes that only one enemy is hit per swing and it is set on fire.<br/>Burn DPS is calculated as (Burn Damage * (Burn Duration / Burn Tick)) / Burn Cooldown.</ref>
$MDREF$ = <ref>DPS assumes that the maximum number of enemies are hit per swing. For burn, it only accounts for the number of enemies hit in a swing.<br/>Ability is not taken into account.<br/>Burn DPS is calculated as (Burn Damage * (Burn Duration / Burn Tick)) / Burn Cooldown.</ref>
$M2DREF$ = <ref>DPS assumes that the maximum number of enemies are hit per swing. For burn, it only accounts for the number of enemies hit in a swing.<br/>Burn DPS is calculated as (Burn Damage × (Burn Duration ÷ Burn Tick)) ÷ Burn Cooldown.</ref>
$TREF$ = <ref>Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Burn Damage × (Burn Duration ÷ Burn Tick).</ref>
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
</var>
